snippet.title: Gameplay Reveal - Everlast: Undying Tale | Steam
snippet.description:
A short trailer showing some gameplay elements for our upcoming co-op action RPG game, Everlast: Undying Tale! Follow the channel for more videos on the way. Be sure to join our discord for the latest updates and news, as well as unique prize opportunities coming soon and more!

Wishlist us on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3818450/Everlast_Undying_Tale/

Join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/yhapsP6k2a

Music Credit: Alexander Nakarada "Adventure Beyond"
